# Nature Trails

> > Nature Trails offers eco-friendly resorts and adventure retreats across India, from Rishikesh's riverside camps to Goa's forest stays, Mumbai-Pune weekend getaways, and Hampi's heritage escapes.

Nature Trails operates multiple eco-tourism destinations including Durshet, Kundalika (Kolad), Sajan Nature Club, Rock Valley Goa, and Rishikesh, offering river rafting, ziplining, wellness retreats, corporate offsites, and family getaways. The brand specializes in nature-based experiences combining adventure activities, mindfulness programs, and sustainable tourism across Western Ghats, Himalayas, and heritage sites.
